review.summary: Reviewed both complete, untruncated saved reports and attempt records for this bounded read-only peer-messaging test. Alpha and beta each discovered the other peer via delegation_context {}, each sent exactly one observation (alpha sent ALPHA_READY; beta sent BETA_READY), and each read its inbox exactly once. Beta's actual inbox result contained alpha's ALPHA_READY peer message; alpha's actual inbox result was empty because it read before BETA_READY arrived. Both tasks completed on attempt 1 and neither restarted. Both declared writes:[] and reported no files, shell commands, or edits. Acceptance is limited to this in-plan read-only messaging test; it does not verify external A2A federation or any files.
